doc_class_description: A Sri Lanka Cabinet Decision is an official policy or action agreed by the Cabinet of Ministers, shaping governance, law, and national development in the country.

latest_doc_d.description: Appointment of a Special Cabinet Sub-Committee and an Official’s Committee to address the impact of the El Niño Climate Condition
latest_doc_d.decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-06-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
latest_doc_d.decision_details_body:
- As Sri Lanka is a country highly sensitive to climate change, the risk of occurring changes in rainfall patterns in the country, high temperature and disaster situations such as droughts and floods remain at a very high level due the global climate phenomenon known as El Niño. Consequently, there is a potential for adverse impacts on numerous economic and social sectors. The Government has identified the need to take urgent measures to address the intensity and impact of El Niño conditions, which are confirmed by scientific predictions to occur from the end of this year onwards with the impact of climate change. Therefore, it has been decided to implement a national-level action plan by strengthening coordination among Government institutions, Local Authorities, Non-governmental organizations, Private Sector and community organizations to minimize the possible impacts. Accordingly, the proposal made by the                        Hon. President to take the following steps, was approved by the Cabinet:

(i)	to appoint a Cabinet Sub Committee comprising of the following Ministers to take immediate action for formulating short term, medium term and annual action plans for the management of the water, electricity and food crisis arising due to the El Niño condition, to ensure integrated operations among all Government entities and minimize the disaster risk by making public awareness:


*	Hon. (Dr.) Dammika Patabendi,
	Minister of Environment - (Chairman).

*	Hon. K.D. Lal Kantha,
	Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation

*	Hon. Samantha Viddyarathna,
	Minister of Plantation and Community Infrastructure.

*	Hon. Anura Karunathilaka,
	Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation; and
	Minister of Energy.

*	Hon. Wasantha Samarasinghe,
	Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development.

*	Hon. (Dr.) Susil Ranasinghe,
	Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply.

 (ii)	to appoint an Officials' Committee with the following composition to assist the above Cabinet Sub Committee:

*	Chief of Staff to the President - (Chairman).

*	Secretary, Ministry of Environment.

*	Secretary, Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.

*	Secretary, Ministry of Plantation and Community Infrastructure.

*	Secretary, Ministry of Energy.

*	Secretary, Ministry of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development.

*	Secretary, Ministry of Housing, Construction and Water Supply.

*	Director General of Irrigation.

*	Director General of Agriculture.

*	Director General, Department of Wildlife Conservation.

*	Director General, Department of Meteorology.

*	Director General, Disaster Management Centre.

*	Director General, Mahaweli Authority of Sri Lanka.

*	Director, National Disaster Relief Services Centre.

*	General Manager, National Water Supply and Drainage Board.

*	General Management/Chief Executive Officer, Electricity Generation Lanka (Private) Limited.
